io.name: areset
io.description: Asynchronous positive-edge reset; resets to walk_left

io.name: bump_left
io.description: Bumped on left; causes direction switch to walk right when walking

io.name: bump_right
io.description: Bumped on right; causes direction switch to walk left when walking

io.name: dig
io.description: Command to dig when walking on ground

functional_summary.overview: Moore FSM modeling a Lemming that walks left/right, switches direction on bumps, falls when ground=0, digs when instructed on ground, and splatters after falling more than 20 cycles then landing. Reset asynchronously to walk_left.
rules: States: WALK_LEFT, WALK_RIGHT, FALL_LEFT, FALL_RIGHT, DIG_LEFT, DIG_RIGHT, SPLATTER (dead). Outputs are Moore: WALK_* -> walk_left/walk_right; FALL_* -> aaah; DIG_* -> digging; SPLATTER -> all zero.
Priority when walking on ground: fall (ground=0) > dig (dig=1) > direction switch (bump_left/bump_right).
Walking on ground with ground=0 transitions to FALL_<dir> and increments fall counter; aaah asserted.
Walking on ground with ground=1 and dig=1 transitions to DIG_<dir>; digging asserted.
Walking on ground with ground=1 and dig=0: bump_left XOR bump_right (or both) switches direction; both bumps also switch direction.
DIG_<dir>: continues digging while ground=1; when ground=0 transitions to FALL_<dir> (fall counter starts). Bumps ignored while digging.
FALL_<dir>: aaah asserted; bumps ignored; fall counter increments each cycle. When ground=1: if fall counter > 20, transition to SPLATTER; else resume WALK_<dir> (same direction as before fall).
SPLATTER: all outputs 0 forever until reset.
Bumps during the same cycle as ground disappearing (walking) or ground reappearing (falling) do not affect direction.
areset (async, posedge) forces state to WALK_LEFT and clears fall counter.
